summary: Implemented `Perc` as a `Stat`, exported it through `seaborn.objects`, and added API examples and a v0.12.1 release note. It supports evenly spaced counts and explicit percentile levels, NumPy percentile methods, orientation-aware grouping, and missing-value handling. Verification: `tests/_stats` passed (45 tests) and `tests/test_objects.py` passed (1 test).
